name: turkce-embedding-bge-m3
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-m3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 8194). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (XLM-RoBERTa), full attention, no causal mask
notes:
ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of BAAI/bge-m3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.568 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence None, repo created 2025-10-14.

CAVEAT: the Spearman gain is +0.0025, inside noise; only the Pearson gain (0.8535 -> 0.9096) is material, and it is on the AUTHOR'S OWN Turkish STS validation set, not a standard multilingual benchmark (no MTEB-tr row on the card). No licence is declared on the repo, which is recorded as null rather than guessed. This is the same family as the sibling v1 already in the catalog - checked before creating, they are different repos with different numbers.
